subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world multi-step word problems solved using expressions, equations, or inequalities, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student translates a realistic scenario into an equation or inequality and solves it step by step
exercise.pictorial: Student draws a model representing the problem before writing the equation
exercise.abstract: Student solves a multi-step real-world problem using an equation or inequality and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: cannot translate the word problem into a correctly structured equation or inequality

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
